content: The hf-hub crate provides HFClient for downloading files from HuggingFace Hub. HFClient::new() reads HF_TOKEN, HF_ENDPOINT, HF_HOME, HF_HUB_CACHE env vars. Typed repo handles via client.model(owner, name). Downloads are content-addressed with on-disk locking for deduplication. Error types distinguish RepoNotFound, EntryNotFound, AuthRequired, RateLimited. Optional blocking API via feature flag. Wraps Arc internally for cheap clones.
